depiction.primary_object: upward pointing arrow inside a circle
depiction.composition: centered arrow enclosed by a segmented ring

ambiguity: At small sizes the dashed right half of the circle barely registers, making it look like a plain up-arrow button; it also resembles a WhatsApp/Instagram status ring or a directional north indicator.

modifier_semantics.meaning: in-progress state, partial completion, or multi-part status ring

submit digital files to a portal

reasoning: An upward arrow inside a half-dashed progress circle denotes uploading, backing up, or upgrading software. It fits tech and file-submission tasks where the upload or upgrade action itself is the point, though it is somewhat abstract and easily confused with generic up-arrow or status-ring icons.
